info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Consumer Features
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Consumer Features.** The embedded consumer app — goals, follows, bookmarks, discovery, geo search and sync with the Context Directory.

200.description: The link state. When no link exists only `linked: false` is returned — this is not an error.

post.summary: Link or provision the Context Directory account

201.description: The established link. Idempotent — an existing link is returned instead of a second account being provisioned.

delete.summary: Remove the Context Directory account link

200.description: The link was removed. The Context Directory account is not deleted — the user can re-link at any time.

201.description: One page of teasers with aggregated facets. Empty result (total 0, no nodes) when no Discovery Node is configured or reachable.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

201.description: Same shape as the federated search: the goal content queries are translated into node filters before the fan-out.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List available Discovery Nodes and their status

200.description: One entry per configured node, probed live; unreachable nodes are reported as offline instead of being dropped.

get.summary: Facet configuration for a content type (Redis cached)

200.description: Facet groups for the content type. Falls back to the built-in default facets (content type, date range, price) when no node answers.

get.summary: Load full content from Content Pod for the reader pane/modal

200.description: The full content item plus the pod capabilities the reader needs. Local Studio content is served from the database; otherwise the teaser is resolved first and the content fetched from its Content Pod.

post.summary: Proxy a request to a Content Pod dynamic API

201.description: The JSON body the Content Pod returned, passed through unchanged. The shape is defined by the pod endpoint that was called (comments, reactions, statistics, …), so it is not modelled here.

data.description: Verbatim response body of the pod `/_dynamic/` endpoint

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: Name of each content type in the request's language (English where the registry has none); an empty map when the registry is unreachable.

Content type categories with their members; an empty array when the registry is unreachable.
All countries known to the Context Directory.

get.summary: Region names in one language (Redis cached, 1h TTL)

201.description: A single-use pairing token with the package snapshot already stored behind it, valid for 10 minutes.

200.description: The package for the short pairing code shown next to the QR (XXXX-XXXX; case, dashes and I/L/O are forgiven). Unauthenticated and single-use like the token.

get.summary: Deep link for the pairing QR code

200.description: Deep link to render as a QR code; creates a fresh single-use token on every call.
One page of notifications (newest first) plus the unpaginated total.
Number of unread notifications — used for the badge in the consumer shell.
The notification is marked read (also reported when the ID does not exist).

An archived notification is restored (undo).

get.summary: Browser push availability (not available in Studio)

200.description: Browser push is not available in Studio: always { available: false }.
The notification preferences; a default row is created on first access so this never 404s.
The full preference set after the update. Only supplied fields are written.

get.summary: Consumer API health with dependency detail

200.description: Aggregate health with per-dependency detail. Always answers 200 — read `status` to distinguish healthy from degraded.
Readiness probe — answers 200 in both cases; check `status`.
Liveness probe — no dependencies are touched.
One page of bookmarks plus the unpaginated total. Teaser fields are resolved from the Discovery Nodes and omitted when no node answered.

201.description: The stored bookmark. Re-bookmarking an existing teaser updates the note and returns the same record; teaser fields are not resolved here.

200.description: The bookmark was removed (also reported when it did not exist).
Every bookmarked teaser with its collections, newest first — without teaser data. The library uses it for the bookmarked state on all screens (the paged list is only what is on screen).
All of the user's bookmark collections with item counts, sorted by name.

201.description: The created collection; `itemCount` is always 0.

put.summary: Rename a bookmark collection or change its icon

200.description: The collection was updated. Only the supplied fields are written.
The collection and all its memberships were deleted; the bookmarks remain.

post.summary: Add a bookmark to a collection

201.description: The bookmark was added to the collection. Also reported when the teaser is not bookmarked, in which case nothing was written.

delete.summary: Remove a bookmark from a collection

200.description: The bookmark is no longer part of the collection.

put.summary: Reorder the bookmarks of a collection

200.description: The new ordering was persisted. Also reported when the collection does not belong to the user, in which case nothing was written.

put.summary: Push bookmarks to the Context Directory

200.description: The push to the Context Directory was attempted. Always true — a failing CD sync is logged and swallowed so the client is not blocked.
The Studio user profile, enriched with Context Directory data when the account is linked and the CD answers.
The Context Directory profile after the update. When the CD does not support profile writes the current profile is returned unchanged.
The Context Directory accepted the new password. A wrong current password or a too-weak new password surfaces as an error instead.
The stored consumer preferences; a default row is created on first access so this never 404s.
The full preference set after the update. Only supplied fields are written.
